targetRegion: ordinary Japanese new-town residential park, Kanto-climate reference
purpose: Replace the isolated rectangular WornPathB visual primitive with a causally constructed compacted-soil branch through the park verge while preserving the coarse gameplay collider until Unity runtime verification is available.

sourceAudit.visualRisk: The source is a constant-width 2 x 6 m Cube, 45 mm above the continuous turf, separated by about 530 mm of grass from a fully continuous ParkPathEast curb. In hero/oblique foreground this can read as a floating or placed rectangular soil slab rather than a walked/constructed ground route.

components: legacy WornPathB BoxCollider retained as temporary coarse Unity gameplay substrate with Renderer disabled
compacted granular soil/fines wearing course forming the visible route core
feathered granular shoulders returning the visible route to turf grade instead of exposing vertical Cube sides
ParkPathEast precast curb access opening made by omitting two complete 588 mm modules rather than cutting/interpenetrating a module
existing mineral ParkPath paving retained as the route datum at the mouth
existing maintained turf/topsoil retained as the shoulder/terminal datum
assembly.manufacture: Model the visible branch as a thin compacted granular wearing course placed and repeatedly trafficked over verge subgrade. The mouth is a deliberate whole-module break in the 600 mm-pitch precast curb run. The compacted core retains roughly 40 mm of visible build-up while shoulders feather to turf grade; no vertical soil slab wall is modeled.
assembly.mounting: The route starts at the ParkPath east paving edge, passes through the two-module curb opening, bears directly on the verge/subgrade, then curves northeast and narrows into turf. Existing source collision is preserved separately and never used as visible construction.
assembly.interfacesGapsSeals: Park paving top is 0.060 m. The compacted-soil mouth is 0.057 m, giving a 3 mm drainage/abrasion step without coplanar z-fighting. Curb modules 26 and 27 are omitted as complete units; neighboring modules terminate with their real end faces and leave approximately 1.212 m clear. Outside the entry transition the route shoulder returns to 0.003 m, within 3 mm of turf top, rather than floating above grass.
assembly.orientationExposure: Upward-facing exterior ground receives strong midsummer sun, rain, foot traffic and drying. The open curb mouth receives concentrated passage; shoulders receive less compaction and more turf encroachment. Benchmark state is dry.
assembly.aging: Centerline/frequent-footfall compaction and small long-wave settlement are strongest away from the terminal taper; shoulders retain looser fines and turf encroachment. UV drying is broad. No arbitrary dark dirt patches, disaster damage, impact narrative or painted contact shadow is allowed.
assembly.geometryVsMaterial: Route curvature, changing width, 40 mm class wearing-course build-up, feathered shoulders, curb opening, centerline depression and terminal taper are geometry. Fine gravel, grains, millimetre-scale roughness, restrained color variation, dry roughness and Fresnel response are material/microtexture. Directional sunlight, AO and specular highlights may not be baked into albedo.

material.family: dry compacted pedestrian soil/fines with small gravel
material.finish: dense matte granular surface; compacted center smoother in macro relief but still highly rough optically
material.microstructure: macro compaction/fines distribution at a 6.4 m physical repeat plus 0.30 m detail field carrying grains and small gravel; no directional highlight is encoded
material.uvAging: UV/drying may shift broad value and saturation only through cause-based material variation; it cannot create sun-facing highlights or arbitrary black edges
material.angularFresnelResponse: rough dielectric F0 near 0.04 with only a broad weak grazing lift; no metallic edge flash and no polished/wet response in the dry benchmark
material.uvPolicy: LOD mesh UV0 stores world X/Z metres. Standard material texture scale is reciprocal metres-per-tile: 1/6.4 for base/normal/mask and 1/0.30 for detail albedo/detail normal. Mips/aniso inherited from the generated ground texture set remain mandatory.

weathering.causes: FootTraffic + UVExposure metadata only for the visible branch. Geometry center depression is limited to 2.5 mm plus restrained <=1.2 mm long-wave settlement; the route terminal returns to grade as use intensity diminishes.
weathering.forbidden: No random catastrophe damage, reconstruction cue, crater, painted shadow/AO, baked specular streak, unexplained puddle, wet sheen, rust on soil, or arbitrary repeating stain decal.

lodPolicy.lod0: 48 longitudinal segments x 7 cross-route stations; preserves mouth fit, spline curvature, shoulder feather, center depression and terminal taper.
lodPolicy.lod1: 28 longitudinal segments x 7 stations; preserves identical physical interfaces and cross-section while reducing along-route tessellation.
lodPolicy.lod2: 16 longitudinal segments x 5 stations; retains full route silhouette, mouth/terminal positions and outer shoulder grade; only intermediate shoulder sampling is reduced.
lodPolicy.lod3: 8 longitudinal segments x 5 stations; retains the same route endpoints, curb-opening relationship and outer silhouette; it never reverts to the legacy Cube.
lodPolicy.transitionPolicy: Four Unity LOD levels use animated CrossFade. LOD bounds must stay within 35 mm center drift and 55 mm size-vector drift relative to LOD0. Visible pop/shimmer can only be cleared from real temporal evidence.

evidencePlan: hero full frame: reject if the former 2 x 6 m rectangular soil slab silhouette or a disconnected soil rectangle is visible
oblique/vegetation_grounding 100% crop: inspect two-module curb opening, ParkPath-to-soil mouth height, shoulder-to-turf feathering, route curvature and absence of floating/interpenetrating geometry
grazing/tree_shadow_contact 100% crop where route is visible: inspect dry rough dielectric response, granular normal breakup, curb end faces and absence of baked highlights
temporal oblique/LOD walk: reject visible route silhouette pop, legacy Cube reappearance, macro/detail texture swimming, high-frequency shimmer or curb-module pop
criticalFailPrevention: Disable the source WornPathB primitive Renderer while retaining its collider as temporary gameplay fallback.
Never model the visual route as a constant-width rectangular Cube or expose a vertical soil slab side in benchmark framing.
Suppress exactly complete ParkPathEast curb modules 26 and 27; do not cut a module with overlapping soil geometry.
Require dry dielectric metallic <=0.01, no emission and no baked directional highlight/AO in the soil material.
Use metre UVs with common physical macro/detail scale across all four LOD meshes to prevent obvious texture restarts.
Require cause-based FootTraffic/UV weathering metadata on every rendered LOD, with no disaster/reconstruction content.
Require LOD0/1/2/3 authored meshes and animated cross-fade; no LOD may fall back to the primitive source.
Do not claim the route visually grounded or PASS until actual sealed 3840x2160 and temporal pixels demonstrate it.

expectedVisualScoreImpactPendingRender.GeometryConstruction: Potentially removes a foreground rectangular-placeholder / disconnected-interface deduction and improves curb/path construction causality.
expectedVisualScoreImpactPendingRender.MaterialPBR: Metric dry-soil PBR binding avoids primitive UV scale and impossible metallic response.
expectedVisualScoreImpactPendingRender.TextureMicrodetail: World-metre UV0 plus existing two-frequency ground textures reduces visible scale reset/repetition risk.
expectedVisualScoreImpactPendingRender.WeatheringContext: Foot-traffic geometry and taper provide a causal use pattern rather than arbitrary rectangular dirt placement.
expectedVisualScoreImpactPendingRender.TemporalLOD: Four construction-preserving LODs remove the need to expose the source Cube at distance. No points may be awarded until rendered evidence exists.
